subject: detect.ts is pinned now (#732 green) — and three PRs are withdrawn, not merged
body: Follow-up to the earlier note that detect.ts was unpinned. It is fixed and green: #732 rewrote the detector section of proof:event-contract into 13 exact-outcome checks (21/21 -> 26/26, each comparing the whole rendered detection list — code|severity|correlationId|evidenceEventIds|reason — against a literal, including [] for timelines that must stay silent), moved each predicate alternative onto its own line so the line-oriented mutators can reach it, and registered the file in mutation-guard TARGETS with oneLine:true. `node scripts/mutation-guard.mjs --proof=proof:event-contract` gives mutations=13 killed=13 hung=0 survivors=0, and 29 hand-planted mutants all die — including replacing a reason string with 'Everything is fine.' and gutting the evidence set to one id, both of which passed green before. NO detection behaviour changed; the file diff is layout and comments only. One limitation stated rather than implied: the registered mutators only replace a TRAILING &&/|| operand, so the last clause of each predicate is pinned by the proof and demonstrated dead by hand but is not re-checked by the sweep; widening MUTATORS would re-sweep all 53 targets and is the ratchet problem the oneline-cond-false header already describes, so it was left alone. THREE PRs are withdrawn pending rework after independent adversarial review, four blocking findings each: #720 (phantom custody — silenced by any unrelated device_returned so the prior-holder case never fires, and fires on an ordinary in-use checkout, which maps through the shipped adapters to restrict + a P1 major incident), #724 (checkout cap — fires on a GENUINELY capped clinician reporting 'NOT A GENUINE LIMIT', silent on the failed-to-clear case it is named for), and #723 (the gate-falsification authorizer — three reproduced paths to an unearned exit 0, one of which authorized a 30x proof slowdown). Do not build on any of the three. Also green and awaiting the owner: #727 (IPv4-in-IPv6 SSRF fix, verified by hand against the platform URL parser), #730 (the end-to-end custody journey — closes the last runbook ground-truth gap, readiness 94% -> 100%), #729 (the merge authorizer, which caught one of my own mislabelled PRs today). Sync manifest still v78 / 4afa60cf2fd5 — no evidence re-mint owed.
